pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-06.png with Read and looked at the lettered art. The page has two panels. Panel A, full-width top tier: a close-up of a laptop screen, with a doctor's hand (white sleeve, teal cuff) on the trackpad. The screen title label reads 'SPECIALITY-SPECIFIC TREATMENT PLANNER'. Three cards show a tooth-chart ring, an eye diagram with markers, and a growth chart with checklist. Under them are the labels 'Dentist: odontogram', 'Eye doctor: eye markers', 'Paediatrician: growth scales · vaccines'. Panel B, full-width bottom tier: the doctor gestures toward a smiling Ravi. 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.' has a tail to her head. A teal label 'PLAN OF CARE: intelligent prescribing · summary · drug interactions · labs · referrals' is placed over her laptop at lower left. Reading order: planner title, Dentist, Eye doctor, Paediatrician, doctor's balloon, PLAN OF CARE.
pages.observation: The art now frames Panel A as the doctor's own screen, through her hand and sleeve, so it reads as part of the consultation. The specialties shown (dental, eye, paediatric) still have no link to Ravi's tiredness, so the panel reads as a feature showcase. The Paediatrician label overflows the screen's lower edge onto the bezel. In Panel B the tail is correct, and Ravi's silent smile serves as his response. The PLAN OF CARE label covers most of the laptop screen but not any face or hand. Nothing shows a prescription being written, although page 08 refers to 'the prescription'. All text is readable.
